# glowkit: full component list

> 683 showcased components of glowkit, an animated UI library for Rust on egui 0.37 (native Windows/macOS/Linux and WebAssembly). Each entry: name, id, `use` path(s), crate and feature, description, web equivalents and its page. Install with `cargo add glowkit`; every component crate is a default feature of `glowkit`. Usage snippets are on each page.

## Text Animations (57)

- **Shiny Text** (`shiny-text`): `glowkit::text::ShinyText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A band of light sweeps across the text, like light catching metal. Equivalent to: React Bits Shiny Text, Magic UI Animated Shiny Text, Motion Primitives Text Shimmer, Transitions.dev Shimmer Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/shiny-text/
- **Gradient Text** (`gradient-text`): `glowkit::text::GradientText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Text filled with a flowing, seamlessly looping gradient. Optional animated border. Equivalent to: React Bits Gradient Text, Magic UI Animated Gradient Text, Magic UI Aurora Text, Aceternity Gradient text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/gradient-text/
- **Blur Text** (`blur-text`): `glowkit::text::BlurText`, `glowkit::text::SplitBy`, `glowkit::text::Direction`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Words or letters come into focus from a blur, one after another. Click to replay. Equivalent to: React Bits Blur Text, Magic UI Blur Fade, Motion Primitives Text Effect (blur). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/blur-text/
- **Split Text** (`split-text`): `glowkit::text::SplitText`, `glowkit::text::SplitBy`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters (or words) rise into place one after another with a springy overshoot. Optional line mask for a pull-up reveal. Equivalent to: React Bits Split Text, Magic UI Letter Pull Up, Magic UI Word Pull Up, Magic UI Text Animate, Motion Primitives Text Effect. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/split-text/
- **Decrypted Text** (`decrypted-text`): `glowkit::text::DecryptedText`, `glowkit::text::StaggerFrom`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Characters scramble through random symbols, then lock into place one by one. Hover the lower lines to decode them again. Equivalent to: React Bits Decrypted Text, Magic UI Hyper Text, Motion Primitives Text Scramble. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/decrypted-text/
- **Typewriter** (`typewriter-text`): `glowkit::text::TypewriterText`, `glowkit::text::CursorStyle`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Types one or more strings, pauses, deletes and types the next, with a smoothly blinking cursor. Equivalent to: React Bits Text Type, Magic UI Typing Animation, Aceternity Typewriter Effect, Motion Primitives Text Effect (typewriter). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/typewriter-text/
- **Rotating Text** (`rotating-text`): `glowkit::text::RotatingText`, `glowkit::text::RotateMode`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Cycles through words with a per-letter staggered slide inside a pill that resizes to fit, or a blur flip. Equivalent to: React Bits Rotating Text, Magic UI Word Rotate, Aceternity Flip Words, Motion Primitives Text Loop. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/rotating-text/
- **Count Up** (`count-up`): `glowkit::text::CountUp`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Numbers count to their target with easing, tabular digits, separators, decimals and prefixes. Changing the target animates from the current value. Equivalent to: React Bits Count Up, Magic UI Number Ticker, Motion Primitives Animated Number. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/count-up/
- **Sliding Number** (`sliding-number`): `glowkit::text::SlidingNumber`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. An odometer: each digit rolls vertically on a spring when the value changes, carrying past 9 like a real counter. Equivalent to: Motion Primitives Sliding Number, React Bits Counter, Magic UI Number Ticker (rolling), Bencho Rolling counter. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/sliding-number/
- **Glitch Text** (`glitch-text`): `glowkit::text::GlitchText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Slices of the text jump sideways with red/cyan channel splits in short, violent bursts. Equivalent to: React Bits Glitch Text, Cult UI Glitch Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/glitch-text/
- **Fuzzy Text** (`fuzzy-text`): `glowkit::text::FuzzyText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Thin rows of the text jitter sideways every frame like a noisy signal; hover to crank up the fuzz. Equivalent to: React Bits Fuzzy Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/fuzzy-text/
- **Circular Text** (`circular-text`): `glowkit::text::CircularText`, `glowkit::text::HoverSpin`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Text set around a slowly rotating ring; hovering spins it faster. Equivalent to: React Bits Circular Text, Magic UI Spinning Text, Motion Primitives Spinning Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/circular-text/
- **Scroll Velocity** (`scroll-velocity`): `glowkit::text::ScrollVelocity`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Huge rows of text marquee in opposite directions forever; scroll over them to kick the speed (scrolling up reverses). Equivalent to: React Bits Scroll Velocity, Magic UI Scroll Based Velocity, Magic UI Marquee (text). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/scroll-velocity/
- **Wave Text** (`wave-text`): `glowkit::text::WaveText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters bob on a travelling sine wave, optionally with a gradient riding the crest. Equivalent to: Animata Wave Text, Magic UI Text Animate (wave), Cult UI Text Wave, Motion Primitives Text Shimmer Wave. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/wave-text/
- **Proximity Text** (`proximity-text`): `glowkit::text::ProximityText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters near the pointer swell, thicken and shift color, nudging their neighbours aside. Equivalent to: React Bits Variable Proximity, React Bits Text Pressure, Magic UI Dock-style text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/proximity-text/
- **True Focus** (`true-focus`): `glowkit::text::TrueFocus`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. One word at a time snaps into focus inside animated corner brackets while the rest stay blurred. Equivalent to: React Bits True Focus. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/true-focus/
- **Sparkles Text** (`sparkles-text`): `glowkit::text::SparklesText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Text with little four-pointed stars that pop in, twinkle and fade around it. Equivalent to: Magic UI Sparkles Text, Aceternity Sparkles (text). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/sparkles-text/
- **Morphing Text** (`morphing-text`): `glowkit::text::MorphingText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Words melt into each other: the old one dissolves into a blur as the next condenses out of it. Equivalent to: Magic UI Morphing Text, Motion Primitives Text Morph. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/morphing-text/
- **Text Generate** (`text-generate`): `glowkit::text::TextGenerate`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A paragraph streams in word by word, each word fading out of a blur, like an AI response. Equivalent to: Aceternity Text Generate Effect, Magic UI Text Animate (blurIn by word). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/text-generate/
- **Highlight Text** (`highlight-text`): `glowkit::text::HighlightText`, `glowkit::text::HighlightStyle`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Animated emphasis drawn onto a phrase: marker swipe, underline, box, hand-drawn circle or strike-through. Equivalent to: Aceternity Hero Highlight, Magic UI Highlighter, Rough Notation-style annotations. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/highlight-text/
- **Colorful Text** (`colorful-text`): `glowkit::text::ColorfulText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Each letter takes a color from a palette; every few seconds they reshuffle in a little blur-and-bounce wave. Equivalent to: Aceternity Colourful Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/colorful-text/
- **Gradual Spacing** (`gradual-spacing`): `glowkit::text::GradualSpacing`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters start squeezed together and spread out to their natural spacing as they fade in. Equivalent to: Magic UI Gradual Spacing. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/gradual-spacing/
- **Text Roll** (`text-roll`): `glowkit::text::TextRoll`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters roll up and out while copies roll in from below, staggered. Holds while hovered; great for menus. Equivalent to: Motion Primitives Text Roll, Cult UI Text Roll, Magic UI Flip Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/text-roll/
- **Shuffle Text** (`shuffle-text`): `glowkit::text::ShuffleText`, `glowkit::text::ShuffleDirection`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Each letter is a little slot-machine reel that spins through random letters and lands on the real one. Equivalent to: React Bits Shuffle, Magic UI Hyper Text (reel). https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/shuffle-text/
- **Scroll Reveal** (`scroll-reveal-text`): `glowkit::text::ScrollRevealText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A paragraph whose words brighten progressively from faint to full, driven by time, your own progress value or its scroll position. Equivalent to: React Bits Scroll Reveal, Magic UI Text Reveal, Aceternity Text Reveal. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/scroll-reveal-text/
- **Line Shadow Text** (`line-shadow-text`): `glowkit::text::LineShadowText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Bold text with an offset shadow made of diagonal stripes that keep sliding through it. Equivalent to: Magic UI Line Shadow Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/line-shadow-text/
- **Falling Text** (`falling-text`): `glowkit::text::FallingText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Click and the words drop under gravity, tumble, bounce and pile up; drag through the pile to shove them, click again to send them home. Equivalent to: React Bits Falling Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/falling-text/
- **Animated Underline** (`animated-underline`): `glowkit::text::AnimatedUnderline`, `glowkit::text::UnderlineOrigin`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Link text whose underline draws in from the left on hover and slides out to the right when the pointer leaves. Equivalent to: Hover.dev Underline links, Aceternity Navbar hover underline, Cult UI Animated link. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/animated-underline/
- **Scramble Hover** (`scramble-hover`): `glowkit::text::ScrambleHover`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters dissolve into flickering symbols while hovered and resolve back left to right when the pointer leaves. Equivalent to: Magic UI Hyper Text (hover), Cult UI Text Scramble, Fancy Components Scramble Hover. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/scramble-hover/
- **Box Reveal** (`box-reveal`): `glowkit::text::BoxReveal`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A solid box sweeps across each line and slides away, uncovering text that rises in behind it. Equivalent to: Magic UI Box Reveal. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/box-reveal/
- **Curved Loop** (`curved-loop`): `glowkit::text::CurvedLoopText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A text marquee flowing endlessly along a curved path. Drag it to scrub; throw it and it keeps running that way. Equivalent to: React Bits Curved Loop. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/curved-loop/
- **Text Cursor** (`text-cursor`): `glowkit::text::TextCursor`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A trail of little text or emoji stamps pops out behind the pointer, wobbling and drifting as it fades. A ghost pointer draws loops when you are away. Equivalent to: React Bits Text Cursor. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/text-cursor/
- **Scroll Float** (`scroll-float`): `glowkit::text::ScrollFloat`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Letters float up out of the line, tall and squeezed at first, settling into shape one after another as the progress grows. Driven by time, a progress value or a scroll area. Equivalent to: React Bits Scroll Float. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/scroll-float/
- **ASCII Text** (`ascii-text`): `glowkit::text::AsciiText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Big lettering redrawn as animated ASCII art: denser symbols where there is more ink, rippled by a flowing wave and tinted with a drifting gradient. The pointer bends it like a lens. Equivalent to: React Bits ASCII Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/ascii-text/
- **Scrambled Text** (`scrambled-text`): `glowkit::text::ScrambledText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. A paragraph whose letters dissolve into flickering symbols near the pointer and settle back into place after a moment. Equivalent to: React Bits Scrambled Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/scrambled-text/
- **Comic Text** (`comic-text`): `glowkit::text::ComicText`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Chunky comic-book lettering with a thick ink outline, a hard drop shadow and a halftone dot pattern, popping in with a springy twist. Equivalent to: Magic UI Comic Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/comic-text/
- **Video Text** (`video-text`): `glowkit::text::VideoText`, `glowkit::text::VideoScene`; crate `glowkit-text`, feature `text`. Huge letters that act as a window onto a moving scene (aurora, ocean, lava or plasma) flowing continuously across the whole word. Equivalent to: Magic UI Video Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/video-text/
- **Text Reveal Card** (`text-reveal-card`): `glowkit::effects::TextRevealCard`; crate `glowkit-effects`, feature `effects`. Drag or hover across the card: left of a glowing divider, a hidden line of text shows through with twinkling stars. Equivalent to: Aceternity UI Text Reveal Card. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/text-reveal-card/
- **Text Hover Effect** (`text-hover-effect`): `glowkit::blocks::TextHoverEffect`; crate `glowkit-blocks`, feature `blocks`. A huge outlined word; a radial gradient follows the pointer and lights the outline in color around it. Equivalent to: Aceternity Text Hover Effect. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/text-hover-effect/
- **Pointer Highlight** (`pointer-highlight`): `glowkit::blocks::PointerHighlight`; crate `glowkit-blocks`, feature `blocks`. A rectangle draws itself around a phrase while a pointer cursor glides to its corner, as if someone just highlighted it. Equivalent to: Aceternity Pointer Highlight. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/pointer-highlight/
- **Cover** (`cover`): `glowkit::blocks::Cover`; crate `glowkit-blocks`, feature `blocks`. Text in a box that turns into hyperspace on hover: streaking beams, sparkles, glowing corners and jittering text. Equivalent to: Aceternity Cover. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/cover/
- **Number Pop In** (`tx-number-pop-in`): `glowkit::interactions::PopNumber`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. Old digits sink away one by one; new ones rise from below, small and soft, overshoot the baseline and spring into place, staggered left to right. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Number Pop In. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-number-pop-in/
- **Number Subtle Change** (`tx-number-subtle-change`): `glowkit::interactions::SubtleNumber`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A counter that changes quietly: the old value drifts a few points away and blurs out as the new one drifts in, up for increases and down for decreases. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Number Subtle Change. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-number-subtle-change/
- **Text States Swap** (`tx-text-states-swap`): `glowkit::interactions::StateText`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A status line swaps its words with a tiny lift: the old text rises and blurs out, the new text rises into place from below. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Text States Swap. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-text-states-swap/
- **Texts Reveal** (`tx-texts-reveal`): `glowkit::interactions::StaggerReveal`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. Lines (or words) rise 12 points, un-blur and fade in on a long smooth curve, each a beat after the last; hiding is a quick fade. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Texts Reveal. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-texts-reveal/

Digits on little drums roll to the new value column by column, neighbours ghosting past; each lands with a pull-back and a springy snap past full size. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Spinning Counter. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-spinning-counter/

An AI status label with a soft highlight sweeping across muted text; each new state lifts the old words away and rises in. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Thinking States. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-thinking-states/
- **Reasoning Stream** (`tx-reasoning-stream`): `glowkit::interactions::ReasoningScroll`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A card of agent reasoning that scrolls itself: every beat the text glides up a couple of lines on an ease-out, fading at the top and bottom, looping seamlessly. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Reasoning Stream. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-reasoning-stream/

A reply streams in word by word, each word fading up out of a soft blur a beat after the last, with a caret riding the end. Equivalent to: Transitions.dev Streaming Text. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/tx-streaming-text/

## Backgrounds (63)

Drifting particles with depth, optional constellation links and pointer repulsion. - **Squares Grid** (`squares-grid`): `glowkit::backgrounds::SquaresGrid`, `glowkit::backgrounds::Direction`; crate `glowkit-backgrounds`, feature `backgrounds`. An endlessly scrolling grid; the hovered square fills in and fades as you move on. Equivalent to: React Bits Squares. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/squares-grid/
- **Dot Grid** (`dot-grid`): `glowkit::backgrounds::DotGrid`; crate `glowkit-backgrounds`, feature `backgrounds`. A field of dots that bulges away from the pointer and springs back with a wobble. - **Loot Popup** (`game-loot-popup`): `glowkit::interactions::GameLootPopup`, `glowkit::interactions::GameCue`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A loot reveal: an orb in the rarity color charges and trembles, then bursts into a flash, shock rings, particles and god rays as the item card springs out with its stats. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-loot-popup/
- **Achievement Toast** (`game-achievement-toast`): `glowkit::interactions::GameAchievementToast`, `glowkit::interactions::GameIcon`, `glowkit::interactions::GameRarity`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. Achievement toasts that drop in on a spring, pop their badge with a ring and sparks, sweep a sheen across the card and count down before sliding away. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-achievement-toast/
- **Damage Numbers** (`game-damage-numbers`): `glowkit::interactions::GameDamageKind`, `glowkit::interactions::GameDamageNumbers`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. Floating combat text over a training target: normal hits pop and arc away, crits slam in golden with a starburst and shake, heals rise green, misses slide off. Click the scene to land crits. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-damage-numbers/
- **Crosshairs** (`game-crosshairs`): `glowkit::interactions::GameCrosshair`, `glowkit::interactions::GameCrosshairShape`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A set of dynamic crosshairs (cross, dot, circle, chevron, brackets, scope) that open on a spring as spread grows, with white hit markers and red kill markers. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-crosshairs/
- **Loading Screen** (`game-loading-screen`): `glowkit::interactions::GameLoadingScreen`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A loading screen with drifting level art, the level name in the corner, rotating gameplay tips, a progress bar with a moving sheen, a styled spinner and a pulsing prompt at 100%. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-loading-screen/
- **Level Up Screen** (`game-level-up`): `glowkit::interactions::GameLevelUpScreen`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A level-up moment: rays wheel open, LEVEL UP slams in letter by letter with a shake, the level number rolls over, confetti bursts and stat gains pop in one by one. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-level-up/
- **Kill Feed** (`game-kill-feed`): `glowkit::interactions::GameKillFeed`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A kill feed where new kills punch in from the right with a flash, old ones fade and the rest glide up; headshots get a skull and your own kills a bright frame. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-kill-feed/
- **Scoreboard** (`game-scoreboard`): `glowkit::interactions::GameScoreboard`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A two-team scoreboard: rows stagger in, re-sort with springy moves as scores change (the new score pops), the local player glows, dead players dim with a skull and ping shows as signal bars. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-scoreboard/
- **Character Select** (`game-character-select`): `glowkit::interactions::GameCharacterSelect`; crate `glowkit-interactions`, feature `interactions`. A hero select carousel: cards ride a spring along an arc with the chosen one tall and glowing, the scene tints to the hero's color, stat bars refill and the confirm button breathes. https://ahmedzulfi.github.io/glowkit/components/game-character-select/
